verdict.rationale: Gitleaks ships a well-documented, scriptable official CLI (git/dir/stdin commands, JSON report output, CI-friendly exit codes) confirmed by a hands-on probe running `gitleaks git` and `gitleaks version`, making it directly usable in automated/agentic pipelines without any account or server dependency. Missing for 10: no explicit AI-agent-specific tooling (e.g., MCP server, machine-readable llms.txt) beyond general CI scriptability.
